notes.title: TactiCats is coming to PC, Nintendo Switch & Xbox and has a release date!
notes.notes:
[h3] Hey there, fans of cats and furr-balls! It's time to sharpen your claws! 🐈 [/h3]

Together with Hungry Dingo we are pleased to announce that TactiCats is finally coming to launch! [b]Game will be released here on Steam, as well as on Nintendo Switch and Xbox consoles in two weeks, on February 20th, 2025![/b] 

Knock down your enemies, grow your collection of cute cat-players, use power-ups and complete various tasks & secret challenges in order to win! Time to show everyobody, who's the fluffiest of them all! [b]No holds barred![/b] 🐈‍⬛

We've prepared for you date annoucement trailer, take a look ⤵️

[previewyoutube=c_1DwZSY_8A;full][/previewyoutube]

Consoles game store pages are here! ⤵️
